name: Amore Tech
source:
You will assume the role of a corporate worker named Sirus, who had spent the last 15 years of his life climbing the corporate ladder before managing to land it big. You were hired 5 years ago to be the CEO of a failing start up company named Amore Tech. In that 5 years, you managed to transform a company built on a single dating application into a Fortune 500 company. You happily approached the Board of Directors and requested a raise after your 5 year contract was finished. They refused.

Frustrated and indignant you plan on taking revenge for the injustice at the insistence of your wife. After she makes an unexpected revelation you are forced into implementing the scheme. 4 months after your plans come to fruition you get a phone call that is going to change your life forever.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/OneHandEntertainment]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名叫赛勒斯的职场人士。在迎来真正的成功之前，你花了整整15年，努力攀登职场阶梯。5年前，你受聘成为濒临倒闭的初创企业Amore Tech的首席执行官。在这5年里，你把一家仅靠一款交友应用起家的公司，打造成了《财富》500强企业。5年合同期满后，你满怀喜悦地向董事会提出加薪请求。他们拒绝了。

你既沮丧又愤愤不平，在妻子的坚持下，决定报复这种不公。她随后透露的一件意外之事，迫使你将计划付诸行动。计划成功4个月后，你接到一通将永远改变人生的电话。
